name: Karhunen-Loeve Transform (KLT)
definition: A linear transform that removes redundancy by decorrelating data, closely related to PCA, by estimating the covariance matrix and computing eigenvectors.
summary: The Karhunen-Loeve Transform is a linear decorrelation technique that removes redundancy by transforming volume data into an optimal basis defined by its own covariance structure, outperforming fixed transforms like DCT.
